facts.text: John mentions that some of the younger players see him as a mentor, which he finds rewarding.

evidence.quote: Some of them do see me as a mentor, which is really rewarding.
It feels great to have their trust and admiration.

facts.text: John states that he tries to provide advice and support to the younger players both on and off the court.

evidence.quote: I try to provide them with advice and support on and off the court.

facts.text: John expresses fulfillment in seeing the younger players' growth, improvement, and confidence.

evidence.quote: Seeing their growth, improvement, and confidence is so fulfilling.
It's been great to watch each of them develop and reach their goals - such a reward!

facts.text: John mentions that being a positive role model for the young athletes is something he enjoys.

evidence.quote: Being a positive role model for them is something I enjoy.
Being a role model for these young athletes is so fulfilling.
